question: Should this fix establish most-specific reload-rule precedence for all Gateway reload rules, or should browser-profile hot reload be implemented with a narrower browser-only ordering rule?
rationale: The runtime fix is small, but the generic precedence change is a compatibility contract for core, channel, and plugin reload metadata rather than only a browser-profile implementation detail.

options.title: Accept Most-Specific Precedence After Docs
options.body: Update the browser docs, then merge with longest-prefix reload matching as the intended contract for overlapping reload rules.

options.title: Narrow To Browser Metadata Only
options.body: Keep first-match semantics globally and make only the browser plugin's own reload metadata order produce the desired profile override.

options.title: Pause For Reload API Review
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers decide whether plugin reload metadata may override broader core restart rules by specificity.

recommendation.title: Accept Most-Specific Precedence After Docs
recommendation.body: Update the browser docs, then merge with longest-prefix reload matching as the intended contract for overlapping reload rules.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combination of repo ownership, browser plugin history, and gateway reload-adjacent history for this compatibility decision.
